# launchR

> Start an R package with tests, CI and GitHub set up, or add ready-made CI and a quality gate to an existing package.

## Tools

- [launchR](https://launchr.example.com/): a form that builds a package zip in your browser.

## Articles

- [R Engineering Playbook](https://insightsurge-dev.web.app/blog): articles on engineering practice for R packages.
